correctness.rationale: Independently built C=L(Q3) with 12 vertices and 24 edges, enumerating all 2648 matching faces f=(24,204,744,1116,528,32). Replayed 1287 Morse pairs and checked all 9936 directed Hasse incidences are acyclic. There are one critical 0-cell, 65 critical 3-cells and eight critical 4-cells. A separate exact signed integral gradient-path recurrence recomputed their 65×8 Morse boundary; row indices (2,15,5,40,42,19,51,56) form precisely the diagonal matrix -I8, so the attaching vectors span a primitive rank-8 summand and cancel eight 3-spheres. Using π3(∨S3)≅H3 and absence of lower cells proves ∨57 S3, not merely mod-2 homology.

evidence: Bayer et al prove outerplanar matching complexes wedge or contractible; Engström gives claw-free independence connectivity.
